subject: Promo kits: vendor quote, artwork proof, and expedited shipping options
messages:
From: Sally Park <sally@printco.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Cho <tom.cho@spinupconf.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Promo kit proofs and quote — SpinUp SF May event

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the RFP. Attached are the initial artwork proofs for the promo kits (promo-kits-v2-proof.pdf) and our line-item quote (printco-quote-0309.xlsx). Highlights:
- Lead time: standard production 10 business days from approval.
- Current stock note: charcoal tee (Unisex L) is low and may be backordered; estimated replenishment is 2–3 weeks after production starts.
- We can split the order and ship ready items immediately, but tees affected by the backorder would ship separately.
- Airfreight estimate for any expedited portion is attached (airfreight-estimate-0309.pdf).

If you want to avoid a two-shipment scenario, the easiest option is to swap to the navy heather tee (same SKU family) — availability is confirmed. Pricing delta is minimal (see quote).

Let me know which route you prefer and if you want us to hold for consolidated shipping.

Attachments: promo-kits-v2-proof.pdf, printco-quote-0309.xlsx, airfreight-estimate-0309.pdf

Best,
Sally Park
Account Manager | PrintCo Solutions
phone: (415) 555-0124

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Sally Park <sally@printco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo kit proofs and quote — SpinUp SF May event

Hi Sally — thanks for the quick turnaround and the materials. A few clarifying items before we sign off:

1) Event deadline: SpinUp's exhibitor move-in is May 5 and booth install is May 6. We need at least the majority of kits on-site by May 4 EOD to support pre-event setup. Can you confirm that split shipments could get ~500 kits on-site by May 4 via airfreight?

2) Quantities: total order is 1,200 promo kits as noted in the quote. If we split, target 500 expedited + 700 standard shipment.

3) Tee substitution: navy heather sounds fine if the material matches the sample — can you confirm pantone/print contrast? We prefer to avoid two separate tee styles on the show floor.

4) Cost cap: finance needs a firm not-to-exceed for airfreight and partial expedite. The estimate you sent is helpful but can you provide a capped number for 500 kits (door-to-booth, San Francisco Moscone Center)?

I've attached our internal promo inventory list so you can mark which items are priority for the expedited batch.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-promo-inventory-list.csv

From: Sally Park <sally@printco.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Cho <tom.cho@spinupconf.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo kit proofs and quote — SpinUp SF May event

Grace — quick answers below and updated options attached.

- Airfreight feasibility: Yes, we can get ~500 kits to the Moscone Center by May 4 if we receive final artwork and PO by Mar 23. That allows expedited production (5 business days) + 48–72 hours air transit + local delivery.
- Tee substitution: Navy Heather (PMS 533C) we tested with the print file — contrast with the logo is fine; see updated proof page 3.
- Capped airfreight number: door-to-booth for 500 kits = $3,750 (this includes production rush surcharge, air freight, customs handling not applicable, and local delivery to booth). If you want a safety margin we recommend $4,200 but $3,750 is our committed cap for the run specified.
- Split shipment approach: we will manufacture the non-backordered items first (stickers, enamel pins, stickers, lanyards) and include the navy tees in the expedited batch. Backordered tees (if you choose to keep charcoal) would be a later sea shipment (arrive ~3 weeks after production start).

Updated attachments: printco-quote-0309_v2.xlsx, promo-kits-v2-proof_v2.pdf

Let me know if you give the go-ahead to swap tees and to proceed with the 500-kit expedite. If you prefer consolidated shipping we can hold but arrival will miss your May 4 target.

Best,
Sally Park
PrintCo Solutions

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo kit proofs and quote — SpinUp SF May event

Quick note — we should accept the navy heather swap to avoid multiple tee colors on the booth. Finance is OK to approve up to $4,200 for the expedite if you confirm final counts by Mar 20.

I approve moving forward with 500 expedited kits (navy heather) + 700 standard. Grace, can you finalize the PO and sign-off?

-Marissa
VP, Demand Gen | Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Sally Park <sally@printco.com>, Alex Reyes <alex@venueevents.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Promo kits — PO, delivery instructions, and labeling

Sally / Alex — thanks. We are greenlit internally to proceed:
- Order: 1,200 promo kits (500 expedited, 700 standard).
- Tee color: Navy Heather for entire run.
- Airfreight cap: $4,200 (covering 500 expedited kits door-to-booth Moscone Center).

Sally, please send the final quote and DocuSign PO link. We need the expedited batch to arrive at Moscone by May 4 EOD. Alex, can you confirm dock access and whether the venue requires the shipment to be labeled a week in advance (we typically label boxes with booth: A23)? If there are any venue-specific paperwork requirements please flag them now.

Labeling & handling notes for PrintCo:
- Label each box: "Redwood Inference — SpinUp 2026 — Booth A23"
- Include a manifest inside the first box with itemized contents and contact on-site: Dylan Brooks, +1 (415) 555-0199.

Attachments: (final quote to follow), internal checklist referenced in email thread.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0177
